root_cause: In the hide method, focus restoration occurs before removing the focus trap listener, causing the listener to move focus back to the dialog after attempting to focus the opener.
repair_strategy: Reorder the hide method to remove the focus and keydown listeners before restoring focus to the previously focused element.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the button that opened the dialog after it is closed via Escape key, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility and focus order.
functional_risks: Potential timing issues if any code relies on listeners being present after hide; but hide event is fired before removal, so impact minimal.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the opener.
Verify that dialog remains inert and non-focusable while closed.
Verify that opening the dialog still traps focus correctly.
Verify that multiple open/close cycles do not lose focus restoration.
